description: This module renames volume groups using the vgchange command.

parameters.name: vg
parameters.description: The name or UUID of the source VG. See vgrename(8) for valid values.

parameters.name: vg_new
parameters.description: The new name of the VG. See lvm(8) for valid names.

examples:
- name: Rename a VG by name
  community.general.lvg_rename:
    vg: vg_orig_name
    vg_new: vg_new_name

- name: Rename a VG by UUID
  community.general.lvg_rename:
    vg_uuid: SNgd0Q-rPYa-dPB8-U1g6-4WZI-qHID-N7y9Vj
    vg_new: vg_new_name
